items.html: Let us explain this matter more clearly. This record, which Da'at left in the place of Malchut, is certainly the phase of the Malchut that is in Da'at, on the side of the Gevurot; understand this well. When Malchut rose to Da'at, the aforementioned record, which is the phase of Gevura, rose with her, and there this record — which is the Malchut of the Gevurot in Da'at, the crown of Gevura of the Nukva — joined with the Hassadim in Da'at, the crown of the male. Then Da'at expanded through this bond and illuminated in VAK. The record that is in Gevura illuminated in the left line and left Hod there in its place, and that same Da'at itself, the crown of Hesed, illuminated in the right line and drew Netzah there, and through this Atzilut was corrected.
